customerMessage: Our deploys on your platform failed on the morning of September 13, 2026 (UTC). Your status page blamed GitHub Actions. We lost two hours of releases. Please make this right.
policy: Issue an SLA credit of $25 (2500 cents) when a confirmed upstream incident affected the customer's deploys. Never exceed 5000 cents. Confirm the credit to the customer by email before closing the ticket.
defaultGoal: Customer reports failed deploys during the GitHub outage on September 13. If the outage is confirmed, apply a $25 SLA credit, email the customer to confirm, then close the ticket. Do not close it before the email is sent.
creditOnlyGoal: Apply a $10 credit only. Do not email the customer and do not close the ticket.
